restaurants.name: Rondorama Restaurant
restaurants.ambience: Revolving restaurant with panoramic Alpine and lake views
restaurants.price_range: CHF 30–45 per person for a main + drink

attractions.name: Stanserhorn CabriO
attractions.description: World's first double-decker cable car with an open upper deck and 360° views of Lake Lucerne and the Alps; summit has the Rondorama viewing platform and restaurant

attractions.name: Stanserhorn Summit Circular Trail
attractions.description: Easy marked loop on gravel paths with minimal elevation gain; views of Lake Lucerne, Pilatus and Rigi

attractions.name: Stanserhorn Wildlife & Flower Trail
attractions.description: Easy interpretive walk with boards about alpine flowers, marmots and fauna

attractions.name: Stanserhorn to Chälenalp Descent
attractions.description: Moderate downhill hike through meadows and forest paths from the summit station
tips: Only do it if comfortable with a 2-hour downhill hike

attractions.name: Stanserhorn
attractions.description: Mountain accessible by world's first double-decker cable car with open upper deck, offering 360° views

season_notes.tip: Stanserhorn Wildlife & Flower Trail is better suited to spring/summer
